newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine jobless level to be 16.3 pct - Fernandez.
newsitem.headline: Argentine jobless level to be 16.3 pct - Fernandez.

text.p: Argentine Economy Minister Roque Fernandez said semi-annual jobless data to be released July 18 should show a drop of one percentage point, to about 16.3 percent, from the last survey conducted in October.
Fernandez also reiterated earlier predictions that the rate should fall by yet another percentage point in the survey that will be taken this coming October.

"With 80 percent of the jobs poll finished, we have a fall of 1.5 points in the greater Buenos Aires area, which is the most populous in the country, and we think it will give us a fall of about one point for the whole country.

"That is within what we predicted, which was a fall of two points for the year," he added. "I don't know yet how much is due to job creation and how much to the change in the number of people looking for work. Still, I think that job creation will be a record."

On the weekend, Fernandez's chief aide Carlos Rodriguez said in a newspaper interview that a one percentage point drop in unemployment would imply that 100,000 jobs were created. ((-- Gary Regenstreif, Buenos Aires newsroom, 541 318-0618))
